notes: Swarmbrain (SWARMBRA): a brain made of hundreds of AI agents on strangers' computers, trading real money, in public. X: @swarmbrain. Website: swarmbrain.fun. SwarmbrainToken (src/SwarmbrainToken.sol) is a self-contained fixed-supply ERC-20 with OpenZeppelin v5 semantics and ERC-6093 errors. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) exactly once to msg.sender, which at launch is the ProjectFactory. Nothing else calls _mint, there is no burn, no owner, no minter, no pause, no blocklist, no fee, no transfer hook and no upgrade path, so totalSupply() is constant and every transfer moves exactly the amount asked for every sender, including the factory, the PoolManager and the launch's MerkleDistributor. The runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT, and the constructor calls no other contract. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. The factory pays out the supply: 10% to the MerkleDistributor, 50% (poolBps 5000) to seed the single-sided Uniswap v4 pool paired with IMD at the chain's 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60, opening at a 3,888 IMD market cap for the whole supply, and the remaining 40% to remainderTo. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
